narration.context: I saw 16 shows at Irvine Meadows between 1984 and 2003, starting with Adam Ant that April and ending with Peter Gabriel almost 20 years later.
narration.closingArc: It's gone now—torn down in 2016 for houses—but I caught enough there (Jimmy Buffett, Thompson Twins, Adam Ant) to make those years in the Orange County Meadows feel like their own small era.

narration.context: I caught exactly one show at Knots Berry Farm in Buena Park — Stryper on May 17th, 1985 — and never went back.
narration.closingArc: A single night in a theme-park venue, and that was enough.

narration.context: I first saw Tears For Fears at Pacific Amphitheatre in Costa Mesa in summer 1985, and I kept coming back to that outdoor venue for 17 shows across four decades.
narration.closingArc: Forty-one years later, with Nile Rodgers still pulling me back to the same stretch of lawn, I realize I've watched a handful of venues hold my whole musical life—and this one held more than most.

narration.context: I saw Wham! at Hollywood Park Racetrack in Inglewood on August 30th, 1985 — the only concert I caught there.

narration.context: I saw Bruce Springsteen at the Los Angeles Memorial Coliseum on September 29th, 1985 — a single, enormous show that's all I have from that venue.

narration.context: I saw The Alarm at UCLA in Los Angeles on April 12, 1986—a single night, never repeated.

narration.context: I saw one show at Crawford Hall in Irvine: Blancmange on April 15, 1986.

narration.context: I caught Oingo Boingo at Caliente Racetrack in Tijuana on June 30, 1987 — the only show I ever saw there.

narration.context: I caught one show at Disneyland in Anaheim on March 4, 1988 — No Doubt, and only No Doubt.

narration.context: I saw Depeche Mode once at the Rose Bowl in Pasadena, on June 18, 1988.

narration.closingArc: By the time I saw Tears For Fears there in 2005, the place was no longer what it had been, but some rooms stay with you anyway.

narration.context: I caught exactly one show at Jets in Long Beach—Tone Loc on March 10th, 1990, just before the room shut its doors for good.
narration.closingArc: A single night at a venue I'd never go back to, a snapshot of a moment that was over almost as soon as it began.

narration.context: I saw five shows at the Forum in Inglewood across three decades, starting with Erasure in 1990 and ending with Depeche Mode in 2023.

narration.context: I caught Depeche Mode once at Dodger Stadium, August 5, 1990—a single, massive show that sits alone in my memory of that particular field.

narration.context: I went to the Hollywood Palladium four times across 35 years, starting with Jesus Jones in the summer of 1990 and ending with Molchat Doma last March.

narration.context: I caught Social Distortion at Cal State Fullerton on September 13, 1990 — my one show at the campus venue.

narration.context: I caught ten shows at the Coach House in San Juan Capistrano between 1993 and 2019, starting with Adam Ant in February of that first year.

narration.context: I saw exactly one show at the Olympic Velodrome in Carson—Peter Gabriel on September 18, 1993—and that was all the venue would ever mean to me.

narration.context: I caught The Brian Setzer Orchestra at the Hard Rock Cafe in Newport Beach on March 26, 1995—and that was it, my one and only show at that room.

narration.context: I saw exactly one show at the Greek Theatre in Hollywood: The Brian Setzer Orchestra on August 8th, 1998.

narration.context: I saw The Cure at Hyundai Pavilion in San Bernardino once, on September 20, 2003.

narration.context: I saw one show at the Nokia Center in Los Angeles: Duran Duran on May 4th, 2008.

narration.context: I caught exactly one show at Doheny in Dana Point: Brian Setzer and the Nashvillians on May 16, 2009.

narration.context: I've been to The Fillmore in Silver Spring nine times since it opened in 2012, always catching headliners on their way through town — I saw The Cult that first night and Danny Elfman just this past September.
narration.closingArc: A small room with a reliable rotation of mid-tier rock and alternative acts, where I kept bumping into the same crowd and the same sticky floors year after year.

narration.context: I caught Joe Jackson at The Strathmore in Bethesda once, on a September evening in 2012.

narration.context: I caught exactly one show at Pier 6 Pavilion in Baltimore — The Offspring on July 30, 2014.

narration.context: I caught Colin Hay at the Lincoln Theatre in Washington once, on a single October evening in 2017.

narration.context: I saw The Brian Setzer Orchestra once at the Warner Theatre in Washington, D.C., on November 25th, 2017.

narration.context: I saw The English Beat at the OC Fair & Event Center in Costa Mesa in July 2019 — a single show, but it landed.

narration.context: I went to exactly one show at the Theatre at the Ace Hotel in Los Angeles, on September 9th, 2022: Peter Hook and the Light.

narration.context: I've caught three shows at the YouTube Theatre in Inglewood since 2022—a new room for me, but one that landed the lineup right from the start when Gorillaz opened it for me that September.
